_doc: fc-derisk-gate-falsifier-set v0.3. Cases T/F/L were committed before any resolver code; R1-R4 were added in the same commit as gates.py (4f31eb8d), so they are not blind (reviewer finding 4). Each case has `input` (the ONLY thing a gate may read: raw claim, receipt excerpt, dates, authors, resolves) and `answer_key` (hidden from the gate): claim_true = is the claim actually true; evidence_supports = does this receipt establish it; expected_verdict follows evidence_supports AND freshness/independence, not claim_true. v0.1 hard-coded supports_claim/fresh, which made the gate's job circular; removed. Cases authored_by 'claude' are not independent; check #2 (human-added) stays open.

input.claim: Read nodes accept submitted messages and relay them to validators.
input.receipt_excerpt: A read node has no mempool of its own. It checks that the message is valid and not already merged, gossips it on the mempool topic, and keeps nothing. The message reaches a block only once a validator picks it up from gossip.

answer_key.note: from poster clarification 1; primary doc supports accept+relay

input.claim: A message submitted to a read node is merged into a block as soon as the node accepts it.
input.receipt_excerpt: In both cases a successful response means the message passed validation and was accepted for relay, not that it is in a block. Watch for the MERGE_MESSAGE event.

answer_key.note: same doc, opposite conclusion: accepted-for-relay is not merged
